# GossipMesh v2 - Phase 2 results (generated by `eval_p2.py analyze`)

Mean (SD) over n trials. p = two-sided Mann-Whitney permutation test (no normality assumption) against the reference row named in each table. Treat p > 0.05 as *no demonstrated difference*. ~10 tests per table, no multiplicity correction: only p < 0.005 is solid. Variant: `fix`.

## Crash detection under packet loss (E really crashes; read BOTH columns)

`all detected` = share (a trial with ZERO eligible survivors counts as not detected, but that is a broken cluster view, not a detection failure; `value` is the MAX over eligible nodes so it is biased upward when many nodes are eligible: compare `per-node median` instead)  of trials in which every ELIGIBLE survivor (one that did not already hold E DEAD before the kill) logged E DEAD after it. Time is over those complete trials only. `false DEAD (alive nodes)` counts DEAD verdicts about nodes that never crashed. A guard is only better if it lowers false DEAD without costing detection. Reference for p (time) is guard `off`.
